variants.graph: AIC full INT32 Down -> GM -> AIV original dequant -> original BF16 S cast in UB -> original Add with ready BF16 R -> BF16 Z -> GM -> remaining hooks/HC
variants.benefit: Avoid S BF16 GM store and reload (4n value bytes) if every S reader is contained or otherwise served. Raw INT32 Cube->Vector GM bridge remains.
variants.extra_storage_reference: A simple explicit FP32 merge plan adds R_BF16 2t+R_FP32 4t+S_widen_FP32 4t =10t tile bytes; reusing a dead dequant FP32 buffer can make this 6t. Neither is a universal storage floor or current-tiling fit proof.
assumptions: Use the exact current dequant branch/arithmetic, complete INT32 K sum, channel and per-token scales, then the original BF16 S rounding before original Add rounding.
Bind each routed tile after its pre-add reduction/scaling/output transform and token/feature trim, with matching rank,row,pad,layout and generation. Do not substitute raw MC2 M816/834 for merge M800.
Audit all S/R readers, hooks, aliases and observable mutation/error/capture contracts. Keep required post-add reduction, truncation, ZeroExpertRouter and HC boundaries in original order.

Readiness is tile-local: a new R-ready edge must be acyclic. A persistent shared epilogue cannot wait on routed work queued behind it on the same stream or occupy all resources needed by that producer.

Price changed stream/event joins, extended INT32/FP32/BF16 liveness, UB and GM buffering, finite Cube/Vector contention, graph publication and all-rank progress. No free overlap or removed-launch gain is inferred.

preferred_analysis_frontier: Post-BF16-cast Vector epilogue with fresh output: fewer alias/atomic-specific assumptions than in-place atomic. This is a conditional candidate, not an implementation design or speedup claim.

primary_API_semantics.SetAtomicAdd: A3 BF16 and UB/L0C/L1->GM documented; no automatic zero, atomic mode scope, device-level 2201 BF16 saturation.
primary_API_semantics.Fixpipe: A3 V220 conversion table; Fixpipe floating saturation CTRL mode is distinct from atomic device-level mode. Published support is not combined cast-before-add proof.
